string: TI (psychosis OR psychotic OR schizophreni* OR schizoaffective OR delusion* OR hallucinat* OR catatoni* OR "obsessive compulsive" OR "obsessive-compulsive" OR OCD OR tourette* OR tics OR depress* OR melanchol* OR bipolar OR mania OR manic OR "anorexia nervosa" OR bulimi* OR "eating disorder*" OR "binge eating" OR alcoholism OR "alcohol use disorder" OR "alcohol dependence" OR addict* OR "substance use disorder" OR "substance dependence" OR "opioid use disorder" OR heroin OR cocaine OR methamphetamine OR smoking OR nicotine OR gambling OR kleptomania OR pyromania OR trichotillomania OR paraphili* OR pedophil* OR paedophil* OR "conversion disorder" OR "functional neurological" OR psychogenic OR PTSD OR "posttraumatic stress" OR "post-traumatic stress" OR "panic disorder" OR "generalized anxiety" OR "social anxiety" OR hoarding OR "body dysmorphic" OR autis* OR dissociative OR "personality disorder*" OR "resignation syndrome" OR "pervasive refusal" OR "selective mutism" OR "skin picking" OR "self-injur*") AND (AB (remission OR remitted OR resolved OR resolution OR disappeared OR abolished OR ceased OR cured OR "no longer" OR "complete recovery" OR "symptom-free" OR "symptom free" OR "free of symptoms") OR AB (unexpected* OR incidental* OR serendipit* OR fortuitous* OR surprising* OR accidental* OR unanticipated OR "side benefit" OR "beneficial side effect" OR unintended OR coincid* OR "paradoxical improvement" OR "paradoxically improved")) AND (TI ("case report" OR "case study" OR "a case" OR "case series" OR "single case" OR "year-old") OR AB ("case report" OR "case study" OR "a case of" OR "we report" OR "we describe" OR "we present" OR "single case" OR "case series" OR "year-old"))
notes: Broader companion to PSY_title_v1: syndrome terms in the title (plus autism, dissociative, personality disorder, resignation and pervasive refusal syndromes, selective mutism, skin picking, self-injury), resolution OR unexpectedness terms in the abstract, case terms in title or abstract. Searched through the EBSCO advanced search UI; result list read 50 per page from the page (no export).
